messages:
emily: Quick FYI 1: wea0re seeing a class of billing mismatches traced to clients still using the deprecated header `X-Redwood-Model` set to `v1` while the routing layer canonicalizes it to v2. Result: request logs say v1, meter attributes to v2.

raj: Ugh. That's the header we marked deprecated last quarter but we left a compatibility shim that maps unknown values -> v2. It's meant to be helpful but it's causing ambiguity.

nora: Repro: client sends `X-Redwood-Model: v1-beta` -> shim maps to `v2` timestamp-wise -> runtime trace shows handler=v1, runtime-mapper=v2.

devex-lee: Short-term mitigation: emit a low-sample telemetry event `compat.header_conflict` when header mismatch occurs, with fields (tenant, route, incoming_header, mapped_variant). Sample rate 0.1% to avoid cardinality. That will give us a scoped list of affected tenants.

emily: Good. Also console-level immediate step: add a passive banner on route config page saying "Detected deprecated header usage" with a link to migration docs and a one-click toggle to enable strict header validation for that tenant (FF: `strict_header_validation`).

raj: For billing correctness we need a ledger rule: if incoming header explicitly references a v1 family, prioritize attributing tokens to v1 if runtime trace shows v1 was executed. Otherwise fall back to mapping. I prefer attributing to actual runtime outcome.

nora: Attribution-by-runtime is safest but costly: we'd need to pipe runtime variant tags into the billing pipeline (kafka header) which is a bit of work. Alternate: add a lightweight attribution tag in the request-stage that records "effective_variant" and persist that with usage events.

devex-lee: We can do the lightweight tag quickly: routing layer sets `effective_variant` tag (v1|v2) before dispatch. Billing pipeline already consumes request metadata—should be minimal change. I'll file infra ticket.

billing-bot: alert: header-conflict-delta for tenant: delta-inc +6% invoice drift flagged (route /complete)

emily: For rollout: 1) emit `compat.header_conflict` telemetry + alert. 2) Console passive banner + toggle. 3) Add `effective_variant` tag into usage events (short PR). 4) Offer a temporary grace: attribute by runtime for tenants that opt-in via console toggle for 30 days.

raj: Also need to update deprecation policy: change the deprecation timeline for `X-Redwood-Model` to include an explicit compatibility notice in invoices for the next 2 billing cycles. Legal wants copy reviewed.

nora: UX ask: in Console show a small per-tenant CSV export of header-conflict samples (10 most recent) so support can reach out to integrators. Keep PII redacted.

devex-lee: SDKs: we should add runtime warning logs when SDK detects server mapped header -> if SDK sees `mapped_variant != requested_variant` log at warn level with guidance. Will add to next patch.

billing-bot: deploy: canary header-mapping-metrics (sha: a9b3c4)
